messages:
Zara: hey folks — Zara here, day 1 :wave: trying to build a tiny "who-to-ping" map so i know where to send things. quick list: 1) who owns routing/fallback policy (downgrades, regional failovers)? 2) who approves Dedicated capacity/console access & quota bumps? 3) who owns API docs/SDKs (where do doc PRs go)? 4) who do i page for a production latency spike vs an obvious model-quality regression? 5) any short access request text i can paste into IT? thanks!

Will: welcome Zara :tada: quick answers: routing/fallback = eng-platform. Capacity approvals (permanent increases) go through eng-ops + finance. API docs & SDKs are owned by eng-docs (they review doc PRs — tag @eng-docs). For paging: eng-sre oncall is first for P0/P1 perf/outage. If it's clearly model output quality, include @eng-ml in the page body.

Priya: adding the short paste-ready access snippet (copy into IT ticket):
```
Subject: Access Request — Dedicated Console (zara@example.com)
Requester: Zara (zara@example.com)
Manager: <manager-name>
Team: <team-name>
Purpose: Onboarding + need monitoring access to routing & Dedicated pool for feature X
Scope: read:console, monitor:alerts
Temporary: exp_access:48h
Expected peak QPS: 60
Approvers: manager + eng-ops
```

Eng-ops: fyi on capacity flow: submit capacity request form (link in handbook) with expected QPS, duration, and business impact. eng-ops + finance approve permanent increases; for short tests we grant temporary capacity with a 7-day default. Tag @eng-ops in the request to speed it up.

Security-bot: reminder: if you suspect any data leak or PII exposure, page security@redwood.com and legal@redwood.com immediately. For access requests that include dataset access mention `data_scope` and attach the minimal dataset list.

IT-bot: alternate minimal template you can paste into the IT system (we parse these fields):
```
user_email: zara@example.com
request_type: dedicated_console_access
requested_scope: monitoring,routing
temp_duration: 48h
justification: onboarding + validation of routing for feature X
approvers: manager, eng-ops
note: exp_access=true
```

Zara: awesome, thanks all — filed the IT ticket and pinged eng-ops. tagging @eng-docs for doc onboarding next. if approvers need anything i'll DM. :)
